title: Happy riding. Part 2
creator_credit: Mark Lawton, Euryn Ogwen-Williams, Vis News and BBC Cymru Wales
brief_description: Part two in the series on the art of horse riding. The topic of this film is looking after your pony. Tips on successful grooming and care are given by expert John Bateman and includes use of dandy brush, body brush, curvy comb, wisp, sponge. Use of blankets, plaiting and shoeing are also covered.
